description: London postcode districts ranked on one open-data measure: lowest_crime_rate (police.uk residential crime per 1,000 residents), cheapest_houses (Land Registry median sold price of existing houses; flats are not ranked), most_outstanding_schools (Ofsted), or shortest_commute (needs hub). Optional borough filter, commute cut-off and reversed order (most expensive, highest crime, longest commute first). Ranks are London-wide.

borough.description: Only districts with postcodes in this London borough, e.g. "Lewisham".

hub.description: For shortest_commute: the work hub. canary-wharf (Canary Wharf), city-of-london (Bank / Liverpool Street / Moorgate), kings-cross (King's Cross), westminster (Westminster), oxford-circus (Oxford Circus), london-bridge (London Bridge), paddington (Paddington), stratford (Stratford), hammersmith (Hammersmith), victoria (Victoria), waterloo (Waterloo), farringdon (Farringdon).

max_minutes.description: For shortest_commute: only districts at or under this many minutes.

reverse.description: Worst first: highest crime, most expensive, fewest Outstanding schools, longest commute.

name: rank_london_districts
title: Rank London postcode districts
